answer: Sybil resistance via exit-bond identity: admission needs a bond, and leaving forfeits it. Standing is a kernel of reputation — a vertex in a trust graph whose weight decays unless renewed by verified work that requesters pay for, so the payer funds renewal, not the identity. Cost(n) rises super-linearly per alias AND for any coalition: a bonded identity that stops renewing erodes like a dune, its forfeited bond subsidising the honest quorum. Failure: flat per-seat pricing lets one operator split cost across aliases; the bond must index to per-epoch issuance, not seat count.
